metadata.title: Secure Survey External / Research SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan governing external-facing and research-oriented survey activities involving non-institutional respondents.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: Survey capability supporting external populations, research participants, and community respondents under explicit consent, ethics, and data protection constraints.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: External and research surveys inherit baseline governance, purpose limitation, and consent enforcement from the Secure Survey Platform SSPP.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: External surveys consume institutional and federated identity services only where identity is explicitly required and disclosed.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: Survey access and response submission rely on Secure Network transport protections and monitoring.

props.name: relies-on-sspp
props.remarks: Survey distribution relies on Secure Email application-based send-only mechanisms with explicit consent and purpose declarations.

props.name: external-survey-trust-model
props.remarks: Trust with external respondents is established through informed consent and does not imply institutional or account-based trust.

props.name: identity-collection
props.remarks: Any collection or linkage of respondent identity must be explicitly justified, disclosed, and approved.

props.name: anonymity-default
props.remarks: Anonymity or pseudonymity is the default for external survey respondents unless identification is essential to the stated purpose.

props.name: data-retention
props.remarks: Survey data retention must be limited to the stated research or administrative purpose and reviewed for continued necessity.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: External survey activities align with SP 800-47 guidance for inter-system trust and responsibility definition.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: External surveys invoke additional privacy and security controls due to participant risk and sensitivity.

system-implementation.remarks: External and research surveys are implemented through the Secure Survey Platform under heightened consent, ethics, and data protection constraints.

roles.title: Research Survey Owner
roles.remarks: Defines research purpose, consent terms, participant eligibility, and data handling commitments.

roles.title: Research Ethics Authority
roles.remarks: Approves survey protocols involving human participants and oversees compliance with ethical requirements.

roles.title: Survey Security Monitoring
roles.remarks: Monitors external survey activity, detects misuse, and supports incident response.

control-implementation.remarks: External survey security and privacy controls are inherited from Secure Survey Platform, Secure Identity, Secure Network, and Secure Email SSPPs, with additional ethical and consent-related constraints defined here.
